data: Which of the following POS categories has the highest classification accuracy on the ENDE decoder across all layers?

To determine which POS category has the highest classification accuracy on the ENDE decoder across all layers, I will analyze the data provided in the figure and caption.

The figure shows the classification accuracy for four POS categories (Nouns, Verbs, Adjectives/Adverbs, Other) across six layers (Layer 1 through Layer 6). The accuracy values are represented by color intensity, with red indicating higher accuracy and blue indicating lower accuracy.

From the data:
- Nouns have the highest accuracy in Layer 1 (0.964).
- Verbs have the highest accuracy in Layer 2 (0.915).
- Adjectives/Adverbs have the highest accuracy in Layer 3 (0.781).
- Other has the highest accuracy in Layer 6 (0.943).

By examining the overall trends, it appears that "Other" has consistently high accuracy across most layers, particularly in Layers 5 and 6 where its accuracy is above 0.9. Therefore, "Other" likely has the highest classification accuracy across all layers.

Thus, the answer is "OTHER".
